Subject: Request: security vetting session for Redwood evaluation

Hi Rafael,

We've kicked off an evaluation of Redwood Inference for a pilot at Novacorp. Our InfoSec team needs a standard technical vetting session to validate encryption, data flows, multi-tenant isolation, and SOC evidence before we proceed to procurement. Would love a 60-minute slot to walk through:
- SOC 2 Type II report / attestation details
- Data residency & retention model for hosted API and dedicated/private options
- Encryption at rest / key management (KMS/HSM)
- Network/topology diagrams and access controls
- Incident response and audit logging details

Can you share your SOC report and a high-level data flow diagram in advance? Our preferred windows next week are Aug 17–18 between 09:00–13:00 PT.

Thanks,
Jordan Miles
Security Lead — Novacorp
security@novacorp.com
